layout.body:
To：Mark Albright
From:John Barry
Date:September 13
Subject:Well done!
Dear Mr. Mark Albright.
I want to congratulate you on becoming a partner in our law firm. It's great that this has finally happened. All of the other staff members and l are really pleased.
We will be holding a party in your honor. It will take place tomorrow night at 7 at the Prince Hotel on 11th Street. A meal will be served at the hotel restaurant at 7: 30, and then we will move to the ballroom for some dancing and champagne. It will be a formal occasion, so please dress accordingly. Everybody at the firm will be there, and it will be a great event at which we can celebrate your promotion.
I look forward to seeing you tomorrow.
John Barry

questions.stem: According to the e-mail, where will the party take place?
questions.analysis: According to the e-mail, where will the party take place? 原文：It will take place tomorrow night at 7 at the Prince Hotel on 11th Street. 解析：派对地点在酒店，所以选 A。

questions.stem: What is indicated about the party?

options.B: Each guest must pay a $20 entrance fee.
options.C: There will not be a dressing code.
options.D: It will begin at 7 P. M.

questions.analysis: What is indicated about the party? 原文：It will take place tomorrow night at 7 at the Prince Hotel… 派对晚上 7 点开始，所以 D 正确。 A：不提供晚餐 → 错，原文有 meal will be served B：要收费 → 错，没提 C：没有着装要求 → 错，原文说 formal occasion, dress accordingly

questions.stem: What's the purpose of the party?
questions.analysis: What's the purpose of the party? 原文：congratulate you on becoming a partner… celebrate your promotion 解析：派对是为了庆祝升职 / 成为合伙人。
